clips.title: The story
paras: Across the southern Barrens, Owatanka roams as a swift thunder lizard known to the tauren as Bluebolt. Slaying the beast yields a crackling tailspike, carried to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in honor of the elders’ tradition of learning from Kalimdor’s primordial beasts.

Owatanka prowls the southern Barrens, where tauren hunters speak of him with reverence. Unlike his massive, plodding kin, he moves with blinding speed. The tauren call him Bluebolt, for the storm changed him.

Tauren lore says lightning struck Owatanka long ago. The thunder lizard survived, and the strike filled him with unending energy and fury. Even after his death, his tailspike crackles with stray sparks when handled, a remnant of the storm’s power.

Taking Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo marks a hunter’s prowess and spirit. Jorn recognizes the encounter in the eyes of any hunter who has outmatched the beast’s speed. Presenting the trophy honors Bluebolt’s enduring swiftness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, there is a new power behind your eyes! You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The thunder lizard Owatanka is called "Bluebolt" by the tauren, for within him resides a speed that belies his size. It is said that lightning struck Bluebolt long ago and, fed from the sky's rage, the great beast's energy is without limit.
May his energy flow through you, friend. For you now keep pace with Owatanka.
